name: Ultimate Metro
summary: Compact two-platform metro terminus for reversible lightrail on ordinary electric tramtrack.
description: Ultimate Metro 0.8.4 improves the surface station: four native connecting-platform tiles replace the stretched head-plaza model. The trackbed uses the native embedded-tram material on small original flat strips along the existing paths. The plaza has two small native apple trees in tree beds and four planters with flowering shrubs; side-platform greenery is removed to keep clear of catenary. Vehicle paths, speeds, terminals and underground station are unchanged. New visual assets have no transport metadata. Existing saved geometry is not rebuilt automatically; place a new station to check appearance and boarding. Uses installed game textures, models and materials; no native binary assets are redistributed. Do not remove the mod while its stations remain.
